episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the need for agents to focus on relationship-building and personal branding. The conversation also covers the influence of Zillow and Compass on the market, and the importance of leveraging social media to stay competitive. Agents are encouraged to adapt by embracing new technologies and strategies to remain relevant.
